meta.dc:subject: legislation
meta.dc:rights: the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

section.name: s2
section.heading: Interpretation
section.def: air cargo terminal (空運貨站) means a franchised air-freight terminal at the Hong Kong International Airport; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
alcoholic beverages (酒精飲料) means Schedule 2 dangerous goods known as UN 3065 ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES;
approved container terminal (認可貨櫃碼頭) means a container terminal specified in Schedule 2 to the Dangerous Goods (Shipping) Regulation 2012 (Cap. 295 sub. leg. F); (L.N. 21 of 2021)

Class 1 dangerous goods (第1類危險品) means any dangerous goods— (L.N. 21 of 2021)(a)that are specified in column 2 of the table in section 5 of Schedule 1 with the Division that the dangerous goods belong to specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; and(b)if any specifications are set out in column 4 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods—that meet the specifications; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

Class 2 dangerous goods (第2類危險品) means any dangerous goods specified in column 2 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2 with the number “2.1”, “2.2” or “2.3” specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

Class 2.2 dangerous goods (第2.2類危險品) means any dangerous goods specified in column 2 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2 with the number “2.2” specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

Class 3 dangerous goods (第3類危險品) means any dangerous goods specified in column 2 of the table in Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2 with the number “3” specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous good; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

Class 3A dangerous goods (第3A類危險品) means any dangerous goods specified in column 2 of the table in Part 4 of Schedule 2 with the number “3A” specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous good; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

Class 4 dangerous goods (第4類危險品) means any dangerous goods specified in column 2 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2 with the number “4.1”, “4.2” or “4.3” specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

Class 5 dangerous goods (第5類危險品) means any dangerous goods specified in column 2 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2 with the number “5.1” or “5.2” specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

Class 6.1 dangerous goods (第6.1類危險品) means any dangerous goods specified in column 2 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2 with the number “6.1” specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

Class 8 dangerous goods (第8類危險品) means any dangerous goods specified in column 2 of the table in Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2 with the number “8” specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

Class 9 dangerous goods (第9類危險品) means any dangerous goods specified in column 2 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2 with the number “9” specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
Class 9A dangerous goods (第9A類危險品) means dangerous goods specified in Schedule 3;

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: a place where construction work is undertaken; or

paragraph.name: b

section.def: construction work (建築工程) has the meaning given by section 2 of the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance (Cap. 59);

consumer pack exempt quantity (消費裝豁免量), in relation to any dangerous goods specified in column 1 of the table in Schedule 5, means the quantity specified in column 2 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

def.name: ConsumerPacks
def.leadIn: consumer packs (消費裝), in relation to Schedule 2 dangerous goods, means—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: for pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods—the capacity of the receptacle forming part of the pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods does not exceed the maximum package size (if any) specified in column 9 of the table in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2 in relation to the dangerous goods; or (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: for the dangerous goods that are contained directly without any form of intermediate containment in a receptacle—the capacity of the receptacle does not exceed the maximum package size (if any) specified in column 9 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

section.def:
consumer pack
(warehouse) exempt quantity (消費裝(貨倉)豁免量), in relation to any dangerous goods specified in column 1 of the table in Schedule 5, means the quantity specified in column 3 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
conveyance (運送) means conveyance on land or at sea;

Division 1.4 dangerous goods (第1.4項危險品) means any Class 1 dangerous goods specified in column 2 of the table in section 5 of Schedule 1, with the combination of the numeral “1.4” followed by an alphabet, specified in column 3 of the table, in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

explosive content (爆炸品含量), in relation to Schedule 1 dangerous goods—(a)means the total mass of any explosives contained in the dangerous goods; but(b)does not include the S1DG packaging, wiring or casing that contains the explosives; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
fire service installation or equipment (消防裝置或設備) has the meaning given by section 2 of the Fire Services Ordinance (Cap. 95);
freight container (運貨貨櫃) has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Freight Containers (Safety) Ordinance (Cap. 506); (L.N. 21 of 2021)

general exempt quantity (一般豁免量), in relation to Schedule 2 dangerous goods, means the quantity specified in column 5 of the table in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2 in relation to those dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
general premises (一般處所) means a building or any other place (whether or not an open space), not being industrial premises or special premises;
Group 8 explosives (第8組爆炸品) means any explosives belonging to Group 8 specified in section 2 of Schedule 1; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
industrial building (工業建築物) has the meaning given by paragraph (a) of the definition of industrial premises;

industrial exempt quantity (工業豁免量), in relation to Schedule 2 dangerous goods, means the quantity specified in column 6 of the table in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2 in relation to those dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.leadIn: a building the whole or any part of which—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: is intended for the use of an industrial undertaking as shown on the plan of the building approved by the Building Authority under the Buildings Ordinance (Cap. 123); and

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.content: is used exclusively for the purposes of the industrial undertaking; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: a construction site;

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: a godown;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: any industry in which articles are manufactured, altered, cleaned, repaired, ornamented, finished, adapted for sale, broken up or demolished, or in which materials are transformed, including shipbuilding; and

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: the generation, transformation and transmission of electricity or motive power of any kind;

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: a laboratory maintained by a medical establishment;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: a laboratory maintained by a specified institution as defined by paragraph (9) of Part 1 of the Second Schedule to the Education Regulations (Cap. 279 sub. leg. A); (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: a science laboratory as defined by regulation 2 of the Education Regulations (Cap. 279 sub. leg. A);

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: a medical laboratory supervised by a medical laboratory technologist that is registered under the Medical Laboratory Technologists (Registration and Disciplinary Procedure) Regulations (Cap. 359 sub. leg. A);

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: a laboratory accredited by the Hong Kong Accreditation Service under Hong Kong Laboratory Accreditation Scheme under the charge of the Commissioner for Innovation and Technology on behalf of the Government; or

paragraph.name: f
paragraph.content: a laboratory in an industrial building;

content.content: a private healthcare facility within the meaning of the Private Healthcare Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 633) for which a licence under that Ordinance is in force; (34 of 2018 s. 175 and E.R. 5 of 2018)

paragraph.name: aa
paragraph.content: a scheduled nursing home within the meaning of the Private Healthcare Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 633) for which an exemption granted under section 128 of that Ordinance is in force; (34 of 2018 s. 175 and E.R. 5 of 2018)

paragraph.name: ab
paragraph.content: a nursing home within the meaning of the Residential Care Homes (Elderly Persons) Ordinance (Cap. 459); (34 of 2018 s. 175)

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: a clinic within the meaning of the Medical Clinics Ordinance (Cap. 343);

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: a hospital, maternity home or clinic managed or controlled by the Hospital Authority established under the Hospital Authority Ordinance (Cap. 113);

paragraph.name: ca
paragraph.content: The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong (as defined by section 2(5) of The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong Ordinance (15 of 2025)); (15 of 2025 s. 3)

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: a mental hospital within the meaning of the Mental Health Ordinance (Cap. 136); or

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.leadIn: premises used exclusively by the following person in the course of the person’s practice on the person’s own account and not bearing any title or description which includes the word “clinic” or “polyclinic” in the English language—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: a registered medical practitioner within the meaning of the Medical Registration Ordinance (Cap. 161);

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.content: a registered dentist within the meaning of the Dentists Registration Ordinance (Cap. 156); or

subparagraph.name: iii

section.def: operator (經營人), in relation to an air cargo terminal, means—(a)a person who owns or manages the terminal; or(b)an employee employed by, or an agent engaged by, the person for operating or managing the terminal; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

def.name: PackagedForm
def.leadIn: packaged form (有包裝), in relation to Schedule 2 dangerous goods, means the dangerous goods are—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: pre-packed; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: contained directly without any form of intermediate containment in a specified receptacle;

section.def: packing group (包裝類別), in relation to Schedule 2 dangerous goods, means the combination of the alphabets “PG” followed by a Roman numeral, specified in column 2 of the table in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2 in relation to the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
paint materials (油漆物料) means dangerous goods specified in Part 3 of Schedule 2;
pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods (預先包裝的附表2危險品) means dangerous goods specified as pre-packed in column 10 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

def.name: PublicUtilityCompany
def.leadIn: public utility company (公用事業公司) means—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: The Hongkong Electric Company, Limited;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the CLP Power Hong Kong Limited; or

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: The Hong Kong and China Gas Company Limited;

section.def: prohibited goods (違禁品)—see section 7; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
S1DG package (S1危險品包裹) has the meaning given by section 3 of the Dangerous Goods (Control) Regulation (Cap. 295 sub. leg. G); (L.N. 21 of 2021; E.R. 5 of 2022)
S1DG packaging (S1危險品包裝) has the meaning given by section 3 of the Dangerous Goods (Control) Regulation (Cap. 295 sub. leg. G); (L.N. 21 of 2021; E.R. 5 of 2022)

def.name: Schedule1DangerousGoods
def.leadIn: Schedule 1 dangerous goods (附表1危險品) means—

paragraph.name: a
b
paragraph.content: special Class 9 dangerous goods; or (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: Group 8 explosives; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

section.def: Schedule 2 dangerous goods (附表2危險品) means any dangerous goods— (L.N. 21 of 2021)(a)that are specified in column 2 of the table in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2; and(b)if any specifications are set out in column 10 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods—that meet the specifications; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

special Class 9 dangerous goods (第9類特殊危險品) means any article— (L.N. 21 of 2021)(a)that is specified in column 2 of the table in section 6 of Schedule 1;(b)if any specifications are set out in column 4 of the table in relation to the article—that meets the specifications; and(c)that contains Class 1 dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

special exempt quantity (特別豁免量), in relation to Schedule 2 dangerous goods, means the quantity specified in column 7 of the table in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2 in relation to those dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
special premises (特別處所) means a laboratory or a medical establishment;

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: in relation to Class 2 dangerous goods, a receptacle with a water capacity not exceeding 150 litres;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: in relation to Class 3 dangerous goods, a receptacle with a water capacity not exceeding 450 litres;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: in relation to Class 3A dangerous goods, a receptacle with a water capacity not exceeding 500 litres; and

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.leadIn: in relation to Class 4 dangerous goods, Class 5 dangerous goods, Class 6.1 dangerous goods, Class 8 dangerous goods and Class 9 dangerous goods— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: if the dangerous goods are in liquid form, a receptacle with a water capacity not exceeding 450 litres; or

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.content: if the dangerous goods are in solid form, a receptacle with a volume not exceeding 0.45 m3;

section.def: UN number (聯合國編號)—(a)in relation to Schedule 1 dangerous goods, means the number specified in column 1 of the table in section 5 or 6 of Schedule 1 in relation to the dangerous goods and preceded by the alphabets “UN”; and(b)in relation to Schedule 2 dangerous goods, means the number specified in column 1 of the table in Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2 in relation to the dangerous goods and preceded by the alphabets “UN”; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

uninhabited compartment (非居住間) means any part of a building that—(a)is not a warehouse compartment;(b)is neither used nor constructed for human habitation;(c)does not provide sleeping accommodation; and(d)is separated by walls from any other parts of the building that—(i)are used or constructed for human habitation; or(ii)provide sleeping accommodation; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

def.name: WarehouseCompartment
def.leadIn: warehouse compartment (貨倉間) means any part of an industrial building which is—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: physically separated from the adjoining parts of the building by walls, a floor and a ceiling, and each of the walls, floor and ceiling and each opening of that part of the building meets the standards of fire resisting construction required under regulation 90 of the Building (Construction) Regulations (Cap. 123 sub. leg. B); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: used exclusively for the storage of goods.

section.name: s3
section.heading: Meaning of type in respect of Schedule 2 dangerous goods
section.leadIn: In this Regulation, a type of Schedule 2 dangerous goods is identified by the combination of—

paragraph.name: a
b
paragraph.content: the packing group (if any) of the dangerous goods; and

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.leadIn: all of the following opposite the UN number or the HK number specified in Part 2, 3 or 4 (as the case may be) of Schedule 2 in relation to the dangerous goods—

subparagraph.content: the proper shipping name specified in column 2 of the table in the relevant Part;
the Class specified in column 3 of the table;
the subsidiary hazard specified in column 4 of the table.

section.name: s4
section.heading: Meaning of unit of dangerous goods

subsection.content: In this Regulation, subject to section 5, references to units of dangerous goods are references to units of measurement.
For dangerous goods in gas form, 1 unit equals 1 litre.
For dangerous goods in liquid form, 1 unit equals 1 litre.
For dangerous goods in solid form, 1 unit equals 1 kilogram.

section.name: s5
section.heading: Determination of quantity of Schedule 2 dangerous goods

subsection.leadIn: In this Regulation, a reference to the quantity of any Schedule 2 dangerous goods is a reference to the quantity determined as follows— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.leadIn: if the dangerous goods are in gas form, or in the form of liquefied gas, dissolved gas, adsorbed gas or refrigerated liquefied gas—

subparagraph.content: for pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods—the water capacity of the receptacle forming part of the pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods is taken to be the quantity of the dangerous goods; or
for other dangerous goods—the water capacity of the receptacle that contains the dangerous goods is taken to be the quantity of the dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.leadIn: if the dangerous goods are in liquid form (except liquefied gas, dissolved gas and refrigerated liquefied gas)—

subparagraph.content: for pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods—the volume of the contents of the pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods is taken to be the quantity of the dangerous goods; or
for other dangerous goods—the volume of the dangerous goods is taken to be the quantity of the dangerous goods; or (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.leadIn: if the dangerous goods are in solid form (except adsorbed gas)—

subparagraph.content: for pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods—the net mass of the contents of the pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods is taken to be the quantity of the dangerous goods; or
for other dangerous goods—the net mass of the dangerous goods is taken to be the quantity of the dangerous goods. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subsection.leadIn: In this Regulation, a reference to the quantity of Class 2 dangerous goods mixture is a reference to the quantity determined as follows—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: if the mixture is pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods—the water capacity of the receptacle forming part of the pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods is taken to be the quantity of the mixture; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: if the mixture is not pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods—the water capacity of the receptacle that contains the mixture is taken to be the quantity of the mixture. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subsection.leadIn: For determining the quantity of any Schedule 2 dangerous goods, 1 kilogram is taken to be the equivalent of 1 litre in the calculation of—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the equivalent in liquid measure of any quantity in weight; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the equivalent in weight of any quantity in liquid measure. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: Class 2 dangerous goods mixture (第2類危險品混合物) means a mixture of Class 2 dangerous goods in one or more of the following forms with the vapours of substances of other classes of dangerous goods—(a)gas;(b)liquefied gas;(c)dissolved gas;(d)adsorbed gas;(e)refrigerated liquefied gas. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

part.name: P2
part.heading: Dangerous Goods to which Ordinance Applies

section.name: s6
section.heading: Application of Ordinance
section.leadIn: Subject to Part 3, the Ordinance applies to—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: Schedule 1 dangerous goods, Schedule 2 dangerous goods and Class 9A dangerous goods; (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: ab
paragraph.content: prohibited goods; and (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: any dangerous goods mentioned in section 3(1)(a) and (d) of the Dangerous Goods (Shipping) Regulation 2012 (Cap. 295 sub. leg. F). (E.R. 2 of 2012)

section.name: s7
section.heading: Prohibited goods

subsection.content: Subject to subsection (2), the dangerous goods specified in Schedule 4 are declared to be prohibited goods for the purposes of the Ordinance.

subsection.leadIn: Any manufactured fireworks which explode on impact are not to be regarded as prohibited goods for the purposes of the Ordinance if the manufactured fireworks are—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: brought into Hong Kong on any vessel not carrying passengers;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: goods in transit that are to be directly taken out of Hong Kong, whether or not they are transhipped to another vessel; and

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: packed, marked and labelled in the manner specified in respect of the manufactured fireworks in a Regulation made under section 5 of the Ordinance.

division.name: D1
division.heading: Exemptions in Respect of Schedule 1 Dangerous Goods

section.name: s7A
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of certain Class 1 dangerous goods installed on vessels, aircrafts or vehicles

subsection.content: This section applies to Class 1 dangerous goods with UN number UN 0054, UN 0070, UN 0191, UN 0195, UN 0197, UN 0240, UN 0275, UN 0276, UN 0312, UN 0323, UN 0373, UN 0405, UN 0430, UN 0431, UN 0432, UN 0453, UN 0487, UN 0503, UN 0505 or UN 0507.

subsection.leadIn: The storage, conveyance and use of Class 1 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: installed on a vessel, aircraft or vehicle as part of its equipment; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: used or intended to be used as part of the safety or life-saving equipment of the vessel, aircraft or vehicle.

section.name: s7B
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of special Class 9 dangerous goods installed on vessels, aircrafts or vehicles
section.leadIn: The storage, conveyance and use of special Class 9 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: installed on a vessel, aircraft or vehicle as part of its equipment; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: used or intended to be used as part of the safety or life-saving equipment of the vessel, aircraft or vehicle.

section.name: s7C
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of certain Class 1 dangerous goods installed in fire-fighting or fire protection equipment

subsection.content: This section applies to Class 1 dangerous goods with UN number UN 0070, UN 0275, UN 0276 or UN 0323.

subsection.leadIn: The storage, conveyance and use of Class 1 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: contain not exceeding 10 grams of explosive content;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: are installed in a fire-fighting or fire protection equipment; and

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: are used or intended to be used as part of the equipment for extinguishing a fire.

section.name: s7D
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of certain Class 1 dangerous goods installed in receptacles used for security work

subsection.content: This section applies to Class 1 dangerous goods with UN number UN 0191, UN 0197, UN 0373, UN 0430, UN 0431 or UN 0432.

subsection.leadIn: The storage, conveyance and use of Class 1 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.leadIn: installed in a receptacle that is—

subparagraph.content: used for security work for the transport of cash or other valuables; and
in the possession and under the control of a company licensed under section 21 of the Security and Guarding Services Ordinance (Cap. 460); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: used or intended to be used to produce a sound, dye or smoke effect.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: security work (保安工作) has the meaning given by section 2 of the Security and Guarding Services Ordinance (Cap. 460).

section.name: s8
section.heading: Exemptions in respect of cartridges

subsection.leadIn: The storage in any place of cartridges for any cartridge-operated fixing tool is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of the cartridges so stored in that place does not exceed 5 000 rounds in the aggregate; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate explosive content of those cartridges does not exceed 5 kilograms.

subsection.leadIn: The conveyance of cartridges for any cartridge-operated fixing tool is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of the cartridges so conveyed does not exceed 5 000 rounds in the aggregate; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate explosive content of those cartridges does not exceed 5 kilograms.

subsection.content: The use of cartridges the storage of which in any place is, by virtue of subsection (2), exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.

subsection.leadIn: The storage or conveyance by a person in or from any place of cartridges for small arms or safety cartridges, not exceeding 1 000 rounds in the aggregate, is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: a licence has been granted to that person (or in the case of a corporation, to a responsible officer of the corporation on its behalf) under the Firearms and Ammunition Ordinance (Cap. 238) authorizing the storage of those cartridges in that place by that person or the removal of those cartridges from that place by that person (as the case may be); or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: by virtue of Part II of that Ordinance, that Ordinance does not apply to the possession of, or dealing in, those cartridges by that person.

subsection.leadIn: The use by a person of cartridges for small arms or safety cartridges is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: a licence has been granted to that person (or in the case of a corporation, to a responsible officer of the corporation on its behalf) under the Firearms and Ammunition Ordinance (Cap. 238) authorizing the use of those cartridges by that person; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: by virtue of Part II of that Ordinance, that Ordinance does not apply to the possession of, or dealing in, those cartridges by that person.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: cartridge-operated fixing tool (槍彈推動打釘工具) has the meaning given by regulation 2 of the Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Cartridge-Operated Fixing Tools) Regulations (Cap. 59 sub. leg. R). (L.N. 21 of 2021)

section.name: s8A
section.heading: Conveyance of Schedule 1 dangerous goods in approved container terminals
section.content: The conveyance of Schedule 1 dangerous goods in an approved container terminal is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are contained in a freight container.

section.name: s8B
section.heading: Storage and conveyance of Group 8 explosives

subsection.content: The storage in any place of Group 8 explosives is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the explosives are not stored in the place together with any other Schedule 1 dangerous goods.
The conveyance of Group 8 explosives is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the explosives are not conveyed together with any other Schedule 1 dangerous goods.

section.name: s8C
section.heading: Conveyance of intact special Class 9 S1DG

subsection.content: The conveyance of intact special Class 9 S1DG is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are not conveyed together with any other dangerous goods.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: intact special Class 9 S1DG (原封S1第9類特殊危險品) has the meaning given by section 3 of the Dangerous Goods (Control) Regulation (Cap. 295 sub. leg. G). (E.R. 5 of 2022)

section.name: s8D
section.heading: Conveyance of Division 1.4 dangerous goods in Hong Kong International Airport
section.leadIn: The conveyance of Division 1.4 dangerous goods in the Hong Kong International Airport is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: within the meaning of section 2 of the Dangerous Goods (Consignment by Air) (Safety) Ordinance (Cap. 384); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.leadIn: goods in transit—

subparagraph.content: brought into Hong Kong by an aircraft; and
to be directly taken out of Hong Kong, whether or not by another aircraft to which they are transhipped.

section.name: s8E
section.heading: Storage of Division 1.4 dangerous goods in air cargo terminals

subsection.leadIn: The storage of Division 1.4 dangerous goods in an air cargo terminal is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the dangerous goods are within the meaning of section 2 of the Dangerous Goods (Consignment by Air) (Safety) Ordinance (Cap. 384);

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.leadIn: the dangerous goods are goods in transit—

subparagraph.content: brought into Hong Kong by an aircraft; and
to be directly taken out of Hong Kong, whether or not by another aircraft to which they are transhipped;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: the aggregate explosive content of the dangerous goods does not exceed 250 kilograms;

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.leadIn: if the aggregate explosive content of the dangerous goods exceeds 250 kilograms—

subparagraph.content: the dangerous goods are contained in more than one S1DG package;
the S1DG packages are stored in more than one stack;
the aggregate explosive content contained in each stack does not exceed 250 kilograms; and
the distance between each of the stacks, measuring from one edge of a stack to the edge of the other stack that faces the first-mentioned edge, is not less than 10 metres; and

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: subject to subsection (2), the dangerous goods are stored in the air cargo terminal for not more than 24 hours beginning at the time the dangerous goods are unloaded at the air cargo terminal.

subsection.leadIn: In relation to the dangerous goods that are transhipped to another aircraft that is scheduled to depart within 24 hours beginning at the time the dangerous goods are unloaded at the air cargo terminal, subsection (1)(e) has effect as if the words “24 hours” were substituted by “72 hours” if—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: there is a delay in the departure; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: documentary proof of the delay is submitted to the Commissioner of Mines by the operator of the air cargo terminal at any time within 72 hours beginning at the time the dangerous goods are so unloaded.

section.name: s8F
section.heading: Storage of special Class 9 dangerous goods in air cargo terminals

subsection.leadIn: The storage of special Class 9 dangerous goods in an air cargo terminal is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the dangerous goods are within the meaning of section 2 of the Dangerous Goods (Consignment by Air) (Safety) Ordinance (Cap. 384);

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.leadIn: the dangerous goods are goods in transit—

subparagraph.content: brought into Hong Kong by an aircraft; and
to be directly taken out of Hong Kong, whether or not by another aircraft to which they are transhipped;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: the aggregate explosive content of the dangerous goods does not exceed 250 kilograms;

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.leadIn: if the aggregate explosive content of the dangerous goods exceeds 250 kilograms—

subparagraph.content: the dangerous goods are contained in more than one S1DG package;
the S1DG packages are stored in more than one stack;
the aggregate explosive content contained in each stack does not exceed 250 kilograms; and
the distance between each of the stacks, measuring from one edge of a stack to the edge of the other stack that faces the first-mentioned edge, is not less than 10 metres; and

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: subject to subsection (2), the dangerous goods are stored in the air cargo terminal for not more than 24 hours beginning at the time the dangerous goods are unloaded at the air cargo terminal.

subsection.leadIn: In relation to the dangerous goods that are transhipped to another aircraft that is scheduled to depart within 24 hours beginning at the time the dangerous goods are unloaded at the air cargo terminal, subsection (1)(e) has effect as if the words “24 hours” were substituted by “72 hours” if—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: there is a delay in the departure; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: documentary proof of the delay is submitted to the Commissioner of Mines by the operator of the air cargo terminal at any time within 72 hours beginning at the time the dangerous goods are so unloaded.

division.name: D2
division.heading: Exemptions in Respect of Class 2 Dangerous Goods in Packaged Form

section.name: s9
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of single type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form

subsection.content: The storage of a single type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form in any industrial premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods does not exceed the industrial exempt quantity for that type of dangerous goods. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

The storage of a single type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form in any special premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods does not exceed the general exempt quantity or any special exempt quantity (whichever quantity is larger) for that type of dangerous goods. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

The storage of a single type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form in any general premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods does not exceed the general exempt quantity for that type of dangerous goods. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

The conveyance of a single type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods does not exceed the general exempt quantity for that type of dangerous goods. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

The use in industrial premises, general premises or special premises of a single type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form the storage of which in those premises is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.

section.name: s10
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of multiple types of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form

subsection.leadIn: The storage of more than one type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form in any industrial premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the industrial exempt quantity for that type of dangerous goods under section 9(1); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods in packaged form so stored does not exceed 450 units. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subsection.name: 2A
subsection.leadIn: The storage of more than one type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form in any special premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the general exempt quantity or any special exempt quantity (whichever quantity is larger) for that type of dangerous goods under section 9(2); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods in packaged form so stored does not exceed 300 units. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subsection.name: 2B
subsection.leadIn: The storage of more than one type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form in any general premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the general exempt quantity for that type of dangerous goods under section 9(3); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods in packaged form so stored does not exceed 300 units. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subsection.leadIn: The conveyance of more than one type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so conveyed does not exceed the general exempt quantity for that type of dangerous goods under section 9(4); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods in packaged form so conveyed does not exceed 300 units. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subsection.content: The use in industrial premises, general premises or special premises of more than one type of Class 2 dangerous goods in packaged form the storage of which in those premises is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.

division.name: D3
division.heading: Exemptions in Respect of Class 3 Dangerous Goods in Packaged Form

section.name: s11
section.heading: Non-application to alcoholic beverages and paint materials
section.leadIn: This Division does not apply to—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: alcoholic beverages; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: paint materials belonging to Class 3 dangerous goods.

section.name: s12
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of single type of Class 3 dangerous goods in packaged form

subsection.content: Where a person stores a single type of Class 3 dangerous goods in packaged form in industrial premises or general premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the industrial exempt quantity or general exempt quantity (as the case may be) for that type of dangerous goods.

Where a person stores a single type of Class 3 dangerous goods in packaged form in special premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the general exempt quantity or special exempt quantity (whichever quantity is larger) for that type of dangerous goods.

The conveyance of a single type of Class 3 dangerous goods in packaged form is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods so conveyed does not exceed the general exempt quantity for that type of dangerous goods.

The use in industrial premises, general premises or special premises of a single type of Class 3 dangerous goods in packaged form the storage of which in those premises is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.

section.name: s13
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of multiple types of Class 3 dangerous goods in packaged form

subsection.leadIn: Where a person stores more than one type of Class 3 dangerous goods in packaged form in industrial premises or general premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the industrial exempt quantity or general exempt quantity (as the case may be) for that type of dangerous goods under section 12(1); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed, in respect of industrial premises, 150 units, and in respect of general premises, 100 units.

subsection.leadIn: Where a person stores more than one type of Class 3 dangerous goods in packaged form in special premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the general exempt quantity or any special exempt quantity (whichever quantity is larger) for that type of dangerous goods under section 12(2); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed 100 units.

subsection.leadIn: The conveyance of more than one type of Class 3 dangerous goods in packaged form is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so conveyed does not exceed the general exempt quantity for that type of dangerous goods under section 12(3); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods so conveyed does not exceed 100 units.

subsection.content: The use in industrial premises, general premises or special premises of more than one type of Class 3 dangerous goods in packaged form the storage of which in those premises is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.

division.name: D4
division.heading: Exemptions in Respect of Class 3A Dangerous Goods in Packaged Form

section.name: s14
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of Class 3A dangerous goods in packaged form

subsection.content: Where a person stores Class 3A dangerous goods in packaged form in industrial premises, general premises or special premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the industrial exempt quantity, general exempt quantity or special exempt quantity (as the case may be) for the dangerous goods.

The conveyance of Class 3A dangerous goods in packaged form is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods so conveyed does not exceed the general exempt quantity for the dangerous goods.

The use in industrial premises, general premises or special premises of Class 3A dangerous goods in packaged form the storage of which in those premises is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.

division.name: D4A
division.heading: Exemptions in Respect of Conveyance of Classes 4, 5, 6.1, 8 and 9 Dangerous Goods

section.name: s14A
section.heading: Conveyance of Class 4, 5, 6.1, 8 or 9 Dangerous Goods
section.leadIn: The conveyance of the following dangerous goods is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: Class 4 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: Class 5 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: Class 6.1 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: Class 8 dangerous goods; or

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: Class 9 dangerous goods.

division.name: D5
division.heading: Exemptions in Respect of Classes 4, 5, 6.1, 8 and 9 Dangerous Goods in Packaged Form

section.name: s15
section.heading: Non-application to paint materials
section.text: This Division does not apply to paint materials belonging to Class 8 dangerous goods.

section.name: s16
section.heading: Storage and use of single type of Class 4, 5, 6.1, 8 or 9 dangerous goods in packaged form

subsection.name: 1A
subsection.leadIn: This section applies to—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: Class 4 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: Class 5 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: Class 6.1 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: Class 8 dangerous goods; and

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: Class 9 dangerous goods. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subsection.content: Where a person stores a single type of dangerous goods in packaged form in industrial premises or general premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the industrial exempt quantity or general exempt quantity (as the case may be) for that type of dangerous goods.

Where a person stores a single type of dangerous goods in packaged form in special premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the general exempt quantity or special exempt quantity (whichever quantity is larger) for that type of dangerous goods.

The use in industrial premises, general premises or special premises of a single type of dangerous goods in packaged form the storage of which in those premises is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.

section.name: s17
section.heading: Storage and use of multiple types of Class 4, 5, 6.1, 8 or 9 dangerous goods in packaged form

subsection.name: 1A
subsection.leadIn: This section applies to—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: Class 4 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: Class 5 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: Class 6.1 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: Class 8 dangerous goods; and

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: Class 9 dangerous goods. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subsection.leadIn: Where a person stores more than one type of dangerous goods in packaged form in industrial premises or general premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the industrial exempt quantity or general exempt quantity (as the case may be) for that type of dangerous goods under section 16(1); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.leadIn: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: in respect of industrial premises, 1 000 units; and

subparagraph.name: A
subparagraph.content: with the exception of special Class 5.1 dangerous goods, special Class 6.1 dangerous goods and special Class 8 dangerous goods, 100 units; and

subparagraph.name: B
subparagraph.content: for special Class 5.1 dangerous goods, special Class 6.1 dangerous goods or special Class 8 dangerous goods, 250 units.

subsection.leadIn: Where a person stores more than one type of dangerous goods in packaged form in special premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the general exempt quantity or any special exempt quantity (whichever quantity is larger) for that type of dangerous goods under section 16(2); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.leadIn: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: with the exception of special Class 5.1 dangerous goods, special Class 6.1 dangerous goods and special Class 8 dangerous goods, 100 units; and

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.content: for special Class 5.1 dangerous goods, special Class 6.1 dangerous goods or special Class 8 dangerous goods, 250 units.

subsection.content: The use in industrial premises, general premises or special premises of more than one type of dangerous goods in packaged form the storage of which in those premises is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: special Class 5.1 dangerous goods (第5.1類特殊危險品) means any Schedule 2 dangerous goods with UN number UN 1748, UN 2208, UN 2880, UN 3212, UN 3485, UN 3486 or UN 3487; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
special Class 6.1 dangerous goods (第6.1類特殊危險品) means any Schedule 2 dangerous goods with UN number UN 1671, UN 2022, UN 2076, UN 2312, UN 2821, UN 3430 or UN 3455; (L.N. 21 of 2021)
special Class 8 dangerous goods (第8類特殊危險品) means any Schedule 2 dangerous goods with UN number UN 1791 or UN 2693. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

division.name: D6
division.heading: Exemptions in Respect of Schedule 2 Dangerous Goods in Consumer Packs

section.name: s18
section.heading: Storage and use of single type of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs

subsection.content: Where a person stores a single type of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs in an uninhabited compartment, such storage by that person in that compartment is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the consumer pack exempt quantity for the Class to which that type of dangerous goods belongs.

The storage of a single type of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs in a warehouse compartment is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the consumer pack (warehouse) exempt quantity for the Class to which that type of dangerous goods belongs.

The use in an uninhabited compartment of a single type of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs the storage of which in that compartment is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.
This section applies despite sections 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 17 concerning the storage and use of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in packaged form.

section.name: s19
section.heading: Storage and use of multiple types of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs

subsection.leadIn: Where a person stores more than one type of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs in an uninhabited compartment (whether or not belonging to the same Class), such storage by that person in that compartment is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the consumer pack exempt quantity for the Class to which that type of dangerous goods belongs under section 18(1); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed 1 000 units.

subsection.leadIn: The storage of more than one type of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs in a warehouse compartment (whether or not belonging to the same Class) is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the quantity of each type of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed the consumer pack (warehouse) exempt quantity for the Class to which that type of dangerous goods belongs under section 18(2); and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the aggregate quantity of those dangerous goods so stored does not exceed 5 000 units.

subsection.content: The use in an uninhabited compartment of more than one type of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs the storage of which in that compartment is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.
This section applies despite sections 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 17 concerning the storage and use of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in packaged form.

section.name: s20
section.heading: Conveyance of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs
section.text: Despite sections 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 17 concerning the conveyance of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in packaged form, the conveyance of any Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance.

section.name: s21
section.heading: Exemption from section 10 of Ordinance
section.text: Schedule 2 dangerous goods in consumer packs are exempt from the operation of section 10 of the Ordinance.

division.name: D6A
division.heading: Exemptions in Respect of Schedule 2 Dangerous Goods in Limited Packs

section.name: s21A
section.heading: Exemption from section 10 of Ordinance

subsection.content: Schedule 2 dangerous goods in limited packs are exempt from the operation of section 10 of the Ordinance.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: limited packs (限量裝), in relation to Schedule 2 dangerous goods, means—(a)for pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods—the capacity of the receptacle forming part of the pre-packed Schedule 2 dangerous goods does not exceed the limited quantity (if any) specified in column 8 of the table in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2 in relation to the dangerous goods; or(b)for the dangerous goods that are contained directly without any form of intermediate containment in a receptacle—the capacity of the receptacle does not exceed the limited quantity (if any) specified in column 8 of the table in relation to the dangerous goods.

division.name: D7
division.heading: Exemptions in Respect of Paint Materials and Alcoholic Beverages, in Packaged Form

section.name: s22
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of paint materials in packaged form

subsection.content: Where a person stores one or more types of paint materials in packaged form in industrial premises, general premises or special premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the aggregate quantity of all such types of paint materials so stored does not exceed 250 litres.

The conveyance of one or more types of paint materials in packaged form is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the aggregate quantity of all such types of paint materials so conveyed does not exceed 250 litres.

The use in industrial premises, general premises or special premises of one or more types of paint materials in packaged form the storage of which in those premises is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.

section.name: s23
section.heading: Storage, conveyance and use of alcoholic beverages in packaged form

subsection.leadIn: Where a person stores alcoholic beverages in packaged form in industrial premises, general premises or special premises, such storage by that person in those premises is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the alcoholic beverages so stored does not exceed— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: if the water capacity of each receptacle in which the alcoholic beverages are contained does not exceed 5 litres, 6 250 litres or, if the place in which those receptacles are stored is protected throughout by automatic sprinkler installations, 12 500 litres; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: in any other case, 2 500 litres.

subsection.content: The conveyance of alcoholic beverages in packaged form is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the quantity of the alcoholic beverages so conveyed does not exceed 12 500 litres. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

The use in industrial premises, general premises or special premises of alcoholic beverages in packaged form the storage of which in those premises is, by virtue of this section, exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance is also exempt from the operation of that section.

section.name: s24
section.heading: Exemption from section 10 of Ordinance
section.text: Alcoholic beverages (whether or not in packaged form) are exempt from the operation of section 10 of the Ordinance.

section.name: s24A
section.heading: Conveyance of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in approved container terminals
section.content: The conveyance of Schedule 2 dangerous goods in an approved container terminal is exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are contained in a freight container.

section.name: s25
section.heading: Schedule 2 dangerous goods forming part of machinery etc.

subsection.content: The storage, conveyance and use of any Schedule 2 dangerous goods contained in a receptacle permanently installed in and forming part of any machinery are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are used or intended to be used for the proper functioning of the machinery. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

subsection.leadIn: Without limiting subsection (1), the storage, conveyance and use of any Schedule 2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are used as refrigerants and are contained in— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the air-conditioning system of a vehicle, vessel or aircraft;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the air-conditioning system of a stand-alone electrical appliance;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: the refrigerating system of a cold store; or

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: a central air-conditioning system.

subsection.leadIn: Without limiting subsection (1), the storage, conveyance and use of any Schedule 2 dangerous goods contained in a fuel tank of a vehicle, vessel or aircraft or a fuel tank forming part of any other machinery are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are used or intended to be used as fuel for— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the propulsion of the vehicle, vessel or aircraft; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the operation of the machinery.

subsection.content: Where the storage, conveyance and use of any Schedule 2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance under subsection (1), (2) or (3), the Schedule 2 dangerous goods are also exempt from the operation of section 10 of the Ordinance. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

section.name: s25A
section.heading: Schedule 2 dangerous goods being ingredients of pharmaceutical product or medicine

subsection.content: Subject to subsection (2), Schedule 2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are ingredients of a pharmaceutical product or medicine.

subsection.leadIn: This section does not apply to—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: Class 2 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: Class 3 dangerous goods; and

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: Class 3A dangerous goods.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: pharmaceutical product (藥劑製品) has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Pharmacy and Poisons Ordinance (Cap. 138).

section.name: s25B
section.heading: Schedule 2 dangerous goods being ingredients of proprietary Chinese medicine or Chinese herbal medicine

subsection.content: Subject to subsection (2), Schedule 2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are ingredients of a proprietary Chinese medicine or Chinese herbal medicine.

subsection.leadIn: This section does not apply to—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: Class 2 dangerous goods;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: Class 3 dangerous goods; and

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: Class 3A dangerous goods.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: proprietary Chinese medicine (中成藥) has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Chinese Medicine Ordinance (Cap. 549).

section.name: s25C
section.heading: Schedule 2 dangerous goods in form of elements that animals or plants are made up of
section.content: Schedule 2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are in the form of elements that an animal or plant (whether live or dead), or any part of an animal or plant, is made up of.

section.name: s25D
section.heading: Schedule 2 dangerous goods being ingredients of food

subsection.content: Subject to subsection (2), Schedule 2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are ingredients of food or a sealed package of food.
This section does not apply to any Schedule 2 dangerous goods with UN number UN 3065.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: food (食物) has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Food Safety Ordinance (Cap. 612).

section.name: s25E
section.heading: Class 2 dangerous goods contained in inflated tyres
section.content: Class 2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are contained in an inflated pneumatic tyre.

section.name: s25F
section.heading: Class 2 dangerous goods contained in inflated balls or balloons
section.content: Class 2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are contained in an inflated ball or balloon intended to be used for educational, recreational, scientific or other non-industrial purpose.

section.name: s25G
section.heading: Class 2 dangerous goods contained in lighting devices

subsection.content: Class 2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are contained in a lighting device to enable the device to operate.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: lighting device (照明裝置) means any light bulb, fluorescent tube, neon tube, halogen tube or similar devices.

section.name: s25H
section.heading: Class 2 dangerous goods contained in inflated rubber cushions
section.content: Class 2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are contained in an inflated rubber cushion made of natural or synthetic rubber.

section.name: s25I
section.heading: Class 2.2 dangerous goods compressed at pressure not exceeding 200 kPa (2 bar) at 20°C
section.content: Class 2.2 dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance if the dangerous goods are compressed to the state of being not exceeding 200 kPa (2 bar) gauge pressure at 20°C.

section.name: s26
section.heading: Storage and use of Class 2.2 dangerous goods forming part of fire service installation or equipment
section.leadIn: The storage and use of any Class 2.2 dangerous goods in relation to which no subsidiary hazard is specified in column 4 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2 are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
ab
paragraph.content: the water capacity of the receptacle does not exceed 450 litres; and (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the dangerous goods are used or intended to be used to extinguish, prevent or limit the extent of a fire.

section.name: s27
section.heading: Storage and use of Class 2.2 dangerous goods by public utility companies
section.leadIn: The storage and use by a public utility company of any Class 2.2 dangerous goods in relation to which no subsidiary hazard is specified in column 4 of the table in Part 2 of Schedule 2 are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if— (L.N. 21 of 2021)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the dangerous goods are used or intended to be used to conduct urgent repair works to the supply facilities of the public utility company;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the dangerous goods are stored in the place at which the dangerous goods are used or intended to be used; and

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: the repair works are conducted under the supervision of a person authorized by the public utility company.

section.name: s28A
section.heading: Storage and use of Class 3A dangerous goods used as fuel under certain circumstances

subsection.leadIn: The storage and use of Class 3A dangerous goods in any premises are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance if—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.leadIn: the dangerous goods are used or intended to be used as fuel for—

subparagraph.content: an emergency generator for any fire service installation or equipment as defined by section 2 of the Fire Services Ordinance (Cap. 95);
an emergency power backup facility; or
(if those premises are industrial premises) any industrial undertaking carried out in those premises;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.leadIn: the dangerous goods are—

subparagraph.content: wholly contained in an approved tank; or
partly contained in an approved tank and the remainder are in packaged form;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: the aggregate quantity of the dangerous goods does not exceed 2 500 units; and

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: if the dangerous goods are partly in packaged form—the quantity of the dangerous goods in packaged form does not exceed the industrial exempt quantity, general exempt quantity or special exempt quantity (as the case may be) for the dangerous goods under section 14(1).

subsection.content: If the storage and use of any Class 3A dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of section 6 of the Ordinance under subsection (1), any of the dangerous goods that are contained in the approved tank are also exempt from the operation of section 10 of the Ordinance.

subsection.leadIn: In this section—
subsection.def: approved tank (獲准貯槽) means a tank approved by the Director of Fire Services under section 114 of the Dangerous Goods (Control) Regulation (Cap. 295 sub. leg. G). (E.R. 5 of 2022)

section.name: s29
section.heading: Exemption in respect of pyrotechnic special effects material

subsection.content: Subject to subsection (2), any dangerous goods which are materials within the meaning of pyrotechnic special effects material under section 2 of the Entertainment Special Effects Ordinance (Cap. 560) (but not the manufacture of such dangerous goods) are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance.

This section does not affect the application of the Dangerous Goods (Government Explosives Depots) Regulations (Cap. 295 sub. leg. D) or the Dangerous Goods (Shipping) Regulation 2012 (Cap. 295 sub. leg. F) in relation to any pyrotechnic special effects material. (E.R. 2 of 2012)

section.name: s30
section.heading: Exemptions in respect of Class 9A dangerous goods
section.content: Class 9A dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of sections 6, 8 and 10 of the Ordinance.

section.name: s31
section.heading: Exemption in respect of dangerous goods not mentioned in section 6
section.content: Except as provided in section 6, all other dangerous goods are exempt from the operation of the Ordinance.

section.name: s32
section.heading: Power of Director of Fire Services to exempt

subsection.content: The Director of Fire Services may, in respect of any Schedule 2 dangerous goods or Class 9A dangerous goods or prohibited goods on land, grant an exemption, for a specific case or a specific person, from the operation of section 6, 7 or 10 of the Ordinance. (L.N. 21 of 2021)
An exemption may be granted under this section subject to any conditions the Director of Fire Services specifies.
The Director of Fire Services may vary or revoke any exemption granted under subsection (1).

section.name: s33
section.heading: Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations repealed
section.content: The Dangerous Goods (Application and Exemption) Regulations (Cap. 295 sub. leg. A) are repealed.

section.name: s1
section.heading: Interpretation
section.content: In this Schedule, any reference to a particular group of explosives means the same group as specified in Division 2 of this Part.

section.name: s2
section.heading: Groups of explosives

th.class: align_center border_right_0.75 border_bottom_0.75 border_top_0.75 border_left_0.75 cellpadding_bottom_2.5 cellpadding_top_2.5
align_center border_bottom_0.75 border_top_0.75 border_right_0.75 cellpadding_bottom_2.5 cellpadding_top_2.5

td.class: border_right_0.75 align_center border_left_0.75 border_bottom_0.75 cellpadding_bottom_2.5 cellpadding_top_2.5
align_justified left_indent_23 first_line_indent_-23 border_bottom_0.75 cellpadding_bottom_2.5 cellpadding_top_2.5

tr.td: gunpowder (火藥) means any gunpowder which is a preparation composed essentially of sulphur, saltpetre and carbon.
nitrate mixture (硝酸鹽混合物) means—
any preparation (other than Group 1) which is formed by the mechanical mixture of a nitrate with any form of carbon, or any carbonaceous substance not having explosive properties, whether or not—
sulphur is added to the preparation; or
the preparation is mechanically mixed with any other non-explosive substance; or
any explosives (other than Group 3, 4 or 5) which contain a perchlorate.
nitro-compound (硝基化合物) means any explosives (whether or not mechanically mixed with other substances) which contain a chemical compound which—
has explosive properties, or is capable of combining with metals to form an explosive compound; and
is produced by the chemical action of—
nitric acid (whether or not mixed with sulphuric acid) on any carbonaceous substance; or
a nitrate mixed with sulphuric acid on any carbonaceous substance.

td.class: border_right_0.75 align_center border_left_0.75 border_bottom_0.75 cellpadding_bottom_2.5 cellpadding_top_2.5
align_justified left_indent_23 first_line_indent_-23 border_bottom_0.75 cellpadding_bottom_2.5 cellpadding_top_2.5

tr.td: chlorate mixture (氯酸鹽混合物) means any explosives containing a chlorate.
fulminate (雷酸鹽) means any chemical compounds or mechanical mixtures (whether or not they also belong to Group 1, 2, 3 or 4) which because of—
the great susceptibility of the compounds or mixtures to detonation, are suitable for employment in percussion caps or any other appliances for developing detonation; or

the extreme sensitivity to explosion and the great instability (that is, the readiness to undergo decomposition from very slight exciting causes), of the compounds or mixtures, are especially dangerous.
ammunition (彈藥) means any explosives belonging to Group 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 which are enclosed in any case or contrivance, or otherwise adapted or prepared, so as to form—
any safety fuse or other fuse for blasting or for shells;
any tube for firing explosives; or
a percussion cap, a detonator, a fog signal, a shell, a torpedo, a war rocket, or any other contrivance (other than the explosives belonging to Group 7);
safety fuse (保險信管) means a fuse which—
does not contain its own means of ignition; and
is of such strength and construction and contains an explosive in such a quantity that the burning of the fuse will not communicate laterally with other safety fuses.
firework (爆竹煙花) means any firework composition or manufactured fireworks;
firework composition (爆竹煙花合成物) means any composition used for the manufacture of fireworks which is neither wholly nor in part explosives belonging to Groups 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6;

manufactured fireworks (爆竹煙花製品) means any explosives belonging to Group 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 or any firework composition, which are enclosed in any case or contrivance, or is otherwise manufactured, so as to form—

a squib, a cracker, a serpent, a rocket (other than a war rocket), a maroon, a lance, a wheel, a Chinese fire, a Roman candle, or other article specially adapted for the production of pyrotechnic effect;

td.class: border_right_0.75 align_center border_left_0.75 border_bottom_0.75 cellpadding_top_2.5 cellpadding_bottom_2.5
align_justified left_indent_23 first_line_indent_-23 border_bottom_0.75 cellpadding_top_2.5 cellpadding_bottom_2.5

tr.td: blasting article (爆破用物品) means any article other than explosives belonging to Group 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 or 7, which is capable of producing an effect similar to an explosive effect and is to be used, whether or not as a blasting agent, in any blasting. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

section.name: s3
section.heading: Divisions of Class 1 dangerous goods

subsection.content: For the purposes of this Part, Class 1 dangerous goods are classified into 6 Divisions from Divisions 1.1 to 1.6 specified in column 3 of the table in section 5 of this Schedule, with each Division belonging to a compatibility group referred to in section 4 of this Schedule from A to L (excluding I), N or S.

subsection.leadIn: The 6 Divisions of Class 1 dangerous goods referred to in subsection (1) are as follows—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: Division 1.1: any substance or article which has a mass explosion hazard;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: Division 1.2: any substance or article which has a projection hazard but not a mass explosion hazard;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.leadIn: Division 1.3: any substance or article which has a fire hazard and either a minor blast hazard or a minor projection hazard or both, but not a mass explosion hazard. This Division comprises substances and articles which—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: give rise to considerable radiant heat; or

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.content: burn one after another, producing minor blast or projection effects or both;

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: Division 1.4: any substance or article which presents no significant hazard. This Division comprises substances and articles which present only a small hazard in the event of ignition or initiation during transport. The effects are largely confined to the S1DG package and no projection of fragments of appreciable size or range is to be expected. An external fire must not cause a virtually instantaneous explosion of almost the entire contents of the S1DG package;

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: Division 1.5: any very insensitive substance which has a mass explosion hazard. This Division comprises substances which have a mass explosion hazard but are so insensitive that there is very little probability of initiation or of transition from burning to detonation under normal conditions of transport;

paragraph.name: f
paragraph.content: Division 1.6: any extremely insensitive article which does not have a mass explosion hazard. This Division comprises articles which contain only extremely insensitive detonating substances and which demonstrate a negligible probability of accidental initiation or propagation. The risk from articles belonging to this Division is limited to the explosion of a single article.

section.name: s4
section.heading: Compatibility groups
section.content: For the purposes of this Part, the description of the substances or articles to be classified as belonging to a compatibility group specified in column 1 of the following table is set out in column 2 of the table opposite the compatibility group.

p.b:
Description of Substances or
Articles to be Classified

td.p: Article containing a primary explosive substance and not containing two or more effective protective features. Some articles, such as detonators for blasting, detonator assemblies for blasting and primers, and cap-type, are included even though they do not contain primary explosives.
Propellant explosive substance or other deflagrating explosive substance or article containing such explosive substance.

Secondary detonating explosive substance or black powder or article containing a secondary detonating explosive substance, in each case without means of initiation and without a propelling charge, or article containing a primary explosive substance and containing two or more effective protective features.
Article containing a secondary detonating explosive substance, without means of initiation, with a propelling charge (other than one containing a flammable liquid or gel or hypergolic liquids).

Article containing a secondary detonating explosive substance with its own means of initiation, with a propelling charge (other than one containing a flammable liquid or gel or hypergolic liquids) or without a propelling charge.

Pyrotechnic substance, or article containing a pyrotechnic substance, or article containing both an explosive substance and an illuminating, incendiary, tear-or smoke-producing substance (other than a water-activated article or one containing white phosphorus, phosphides, a pyrophoric substance, a flammable liquid or gel, or hypergolic liquids).
Article containing both an explosive substance and white phosphorus.
Article containing both an explosive substance and a flammable liquid or gel.
Article containing both an explosive substance and a toxic chemical agent.

Explosive substance or article containing an explosive substance and presenting a special risk (such as due to water-activation or presence of hypergolic liquids, phosphides or a pyrophoric substance) and needing isolation of each type.
Article containing only extremely insensitive detonating substances.

Substance or article so packaged or designed that any hazardous effects arising from accidental functioning are confined within the S1DG package unless the package has been degraded by fire, in which case all blast or projection effects are limited to the extent that they do not significantly hinder or prohibit fire fighting or other emergency response efforts in the immediate vicinity of the package. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

section.name: s1A
section.heading: Interpretation
section.def: LQ, in column 8 of the table in Part 2, 3 or 4 of this Schedule, means limited quantity;
N/A, in any column of the table in Part 2 or 3 of this Schedule, means not applicable;
Sub. Haz., in column 4 of the table in Part 2, 3 or 4 of this Schedule, means subsidiary hazard.

section.name: s1
section.heading: Divisions of Schedule 2 dangerous goods

subsection.leadIn: For the purposes of this Schedule, Schedule 2 dangerous goods are classified as follows—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.leadIn: Class 2 dangerous goods, which—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: include compressed gases, liquefied gases, dissolved gases, adsorbed gases, refrigerated liquefied gases, mixtures of one or more of these gases with one or more vapours of substances of other classes of dangerous goods and articles charged with a gas and aerosols;

subparagraph.name: ii
iii
subparagraph.leadIn: are sub-divided into the following Classes—

subparagraph.name: A
subparagraph.content: Class 2.1: flammable gases;

subparagraph.name: B
subparagraph.content: Class 2.2: non-flammable and non-toxic gases; and

subparagraph.name: C
subparagraph.content: Class 2.3: toxic gases;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: Class 3 dangerous goods, which are flammable liquids;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: Class 3A dangerous goods, which includes diesel, fuel oil and furnace oil, having flashpoints exceeding 60°C (closed-cup test);

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.leadIn: Class 4 dangerous goods, which—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: includes flammable solids, substances liable to spontaneous combustion, and substances which, in contact with water, emit flammable gases; and

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.leadIn: are sub-divided into the following Classes—

subparagraph.name: A
B
subparagraph.content: Class 4.2: substances liable to spontaneous combustion; and

subparagraph.name: C
subparagraph.content: Class 4.3: substances which, in contact with water, emit flammable gases;

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.leadIn: Class 5 dangerous goods, which—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: includes oxidizing substances and organic peroxides; and

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.leadIn: are sub-divided into the following Classes—

subparagraph.name: A
subparagraph.content: Class 5.1: oxidizing substances; and

subparagraph.name: B
subparagraph.content: Class 5.2: organic peroxides;

paragraph.name: f
paragraph.content: Class 6.1 dangerous goods, which are toxic substances;

paragraph.name: g
paragraph.content: Class 8 dangerous goods, which are corrosive substances; and

paragraph.name: h
paragraph.content: Class 9 dangerous goods, which are miscellaneous dangerous substances or materials.

subsection.content: The Class to which each type of dangerous goods belongs denotes the primary hazard or the most predominant hazard of the dangerous goods.

For each type of Schedule 2 dangerous goods, the subsidiary hazard specified in column 4 of the table in Parts 2, 3 and 4 of this Schedule in relation to the dangerous goods denotes the hazard other than the primary hazard of the dangerous goods. (L.N. 21 of 2021)

section.name: s2
section.heading: Inhalation toxicity value
section.content: The inhalation toxicity by dusts and mists value of Schedule 2 dangerous goods with UN numbers UN 3381, UN 3382, UN 3383, UN 3384, UN 3385, UN 3386, UN 3387, UN 3388, UN 3389, UN 3390, UN 3488, UN 3489, UN 3490 and UN 3491 is measured in terms of LC50.
